text: `PUT /api/spec-skills/uses-confirmation` replaces the confirmed list whole, and the only read the #skills card has is `exposed-project-row.confirmed` — which is `false` for a name the project does not attach. So the card cannot see a name confirmed on this machine but absent from `skill.uses` (e.g. confirmed with `c4s confirm-skill-uses` ahead of a commit, or left after an attachment was taken off). Assumed: the card's Confirm action and the confirmation written with the save of a newly ticked row send every attached, confirmed name (as the rows show it) plus the new one; a confirmed name outside `skill.uses` is not carried and is dropped by such a write. The CLI is unaffected (it passes its names explicitly).
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-6704 — a confirmed name outside `skill.uses` has no row, so a write from the card does not carry it.
